tooltip.architectstrials.challenge_scrol: Right-click while looking at a block to open a challenge portal there.
Solo: only you can enter, the portal closes behind you.
Portal closes after the first player
Portal stays open until the time runs out
This scroll is not bound to any challenge.
tooltip.architectstrials.exit_marker: Editor marker: becomes the challenge exit. Walking through its portal completes the run. A redstone signal LOCKS the exit; unpowered it is open. Optional bonus loot table: /architectstrials marker loot_table <id>
tooltip.architectstrials.direct_spawn_ma: Editor marker: spawns mobs directly when the challenge is placed (they never despawn). Right-click: spawn egg (stack size = number of mobs) and equipment. Equipment never drops.
tooltip.architectstrials.spawner_marker: Editor marker: becomes a monster spawner when the challenge is placed. Right-click: spawn egg (stack size = mobs per spawn cycle) and equipment. Equipment never drops.
tooltip.architectstrials.trial_spawner_m: Editor marker: becomes a trial spawner when the challenge is placed (never ominous). Right-click: up to three mob types (spawn egg + equipment; total mobs = sum of all eggs) and the number of mobs at once. Reward loot table: /architectstrials marker loot_table <id>
tooltip.architectstrials.player_spawn_ma: Editor marker: players entering the challenge spawn here, looking where the arrow points. Replaced by air when the structure is placed.

architectstrials.configuration.title: Architect's Trials Configuration
architectstrials.configuration.slotSpaci: Distance in blocks between two challenge instances in the same theme dimension. Only applies to theme dimensions that currently have no instances.
architectstrials.configuration.maxConcur: Maximum number of simultaneous challenge instances per theme dimension. 0 = unlimited.
architectstrials.configuration.structure: Y coordinate the bottom of every challenge structure is placed at.
architectstrials.configuration.portalTim: Seconds an opened, ready challenge portal waits for its player before it collapses. The instance is cleaned up and the scroll drops again with a 50% chance.
architectstrials.configuration.startingR: Rank every player starts with in every theme. A scroll of tier N needs level N or higher. 0 blocks all scrolls until the player receives an upgrade.
